title: Batch persona sheet validation for character library import

sections.what: Add a bulk validation step in the character library import tool (`static/js/character-import.ts` and `engine/character_appearance.py`) to validate all characters in a scenario or folder, reporting missing required fields, unnormalized tags, or broken references in a single batch report.
sections.why: When importing a cast of 10+ characters from an external JSON pack or library folder, individual errors currently surface one-by-one upon inspection or compile, causing repetitive context switching.
sections.how:
- Add `validate_persona_batch(characters: list[dict]) -> dict` returning per-character health status and issues.
- Expose a "Validate All Characters" button in the library import dialog and Scenario Wizard.
- Surface summary pills (e.g. `12 valid · 2 warnings · 1 error`).

acceptance.text: Batch validation analyzes all characters in a payload or library folder without stopping on the first failure.
Returns a structured health summary categorizing valid, warning, and broken characters.

custom.verification:
